name: Shandong Yabo Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Shandong Yabo Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the development, production and sale of flameproof transformer. Its major products are dry-type transformers, distribution transformers, mining flameproof movable substations and power transformers. The company was founded on October 21, 2002 and is headquartered in Yancheng, China.
